brief_summary: A phase 2, multicenter study to evaluate the efficacy and safety of twelve once weekly subcutaneous doses of PB-119 to patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) not well-controlled by metformin mono therapy.
brief_title: Dose-finding of PB-119 Administered Subcutaneously Once Weekly Versus Placebo in Subjects With Type 2 Diabetes
official_title: A Phase 2, Multicenter, Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled, Parallel Dose Cohort Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Twelve Once-weekly Subcutaneous Doses of PB-119 to Patients With Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus (T2DM) Not Well-controlled by Metformin Monotherapy

primary_outcomes.measure: The change from baseline value of HbA1c will be compared between treatments
primary_outcomes.time_frame: From Baseline to end of treatment (up to Week 12)
